name: Ovarian / fallopian tube / primary peritoneal
theme: the PARP maintenance era · the HRD fork

meta.title: Ovarian cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Epithelial ovarian / fallopian tube / primary peritoneal cancer (high-grade serous main axis), adult
meta.population: Adults with epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer - one spec, high-grade serous as the main axis (the biology the PARP era was built on), with the low-grade serous / clear-cell / mucinous family as an honestly thinner branch (its own new approvals included) and germ-cell/sex-cord tumors rerouted. The disease of the R0 principle (residual tumor is the strongest prognostic factor), the universal test (germline + reflex somatic BRCA, per the ASCO guideline), the HRD fork that routes the maintenance era - and the registry's LARGEST EVIDENCE-REVERSAL ARC: four PARP later-line indications withdrawn or restricted in 2022 after OS signals, with the wave reaching FRONT LINE in June 2025 when PRIMA's final OS (46.6 vs 48.8 months - placebo numerically better) ended niraparib's all-comers 1L indication. This trainer teaches the wave as one arc, not four footnotes.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the disease where maintenance therapy grew up and then got audited. Upfront: the debulking question (EORTC 55971/CHORUS made interval surgery legitimate; R0 is the point), the carboplatin-paclitaxel backbone (GOG-158), HIPEC's contested single-trial receipt (van Driel - whose citation carries WRONG-PMID CATCH #25: an identical-title NEJM correspondence poses as the paper), and THE HRD FORK: BRCA-mutant disease gets SOLO-1's receipt (7-year OS HR 0.55 - maintenance olaparib as the closest thing to a cure lever this disease has); HRD-positive gets PAOLA-…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: FIGO staging; the HRD fork (BRCA-mutant / HRD-positive / HR-proficient) as the maintenance router; platinum-free interval as the calendar biomarker (sensitive >=6 months vs resistant <6 - evolving toward a continuum, taught as such); NCCN Ovarian v4.2026 (secondhand - 403)
meta.response: RECIST 1.1 and CA-125 (GCIG) - with the Rustin rule as a first-class checkpoint branch: treating a CA-125-only rise early gave NO survival benefit over waiting for clinical relapse; the trainer refuses to treat a number

Newly diagnosed.name: Staging surgery +/- adjuvant chemotherapy (early stage)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the operation plus, where indicated, a short platinum season
Newly diagnosed.patient: For disease caught early: a thorough staging operation cures most, sometimes with a short chemotherapy course as insurance.

Newly diagnosed.name: Debulking to R0 + carboplatin-paclitaxel (the backbone everyone builds on)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the universal backbone (NCCN secondhand; PDQ live)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized x4+ (EORTC 55971, CHORUS, GOG-158, GOG-218/ICON7) - the receipts verified; the 5-yr figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: major surgery plus the platinum-taxane season (neuropathy, counts, alopecia) - the disease's hardest stretch, walked once
Newly diagnosed.patient: The foundation for advanced disease: an operation aiming for no visible cancer left - before or after some chemotherapy, both proven - plus the standard two-drug chemotherapy. Everything after builds on this.
drugs: Debulking surgery + carboplatin-paclitaxel (+/- bev; +/- HIPEC at interval)

Newly diagnosed.name: Maintenance olaparib (SOLO-1 - the fork's strongest tine)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized, 7-year maturity (SOLO-1) - the maintenance era's deepest receipt
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: nausea and anemia early, usually settling; the MDS/AML counseling line is part of every PARP consent
Newly diagnosed.patient: For BRCA-mutant disease after chemotherapy works: two years of a tablet, then stopping on purpose - seven-year follow-up shows two-thirds alive, the strongest maintenance result this disease has.

Newly diagnosed.name: Maintenance for HRD-positive disease (PAOLA-1's tine)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: HRD-positive 1L maintenance standard (NCCN secondhand); niraparib per the narrowed label
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized with final OS in HRD+ (PAOLA-1, verified) - the figure flagged pending exact pull
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the PARP ledger plus bevacizumab's pressure-and-protein watch
Newly diagnosed.patient: For tumors with the broader DNA-repair deficiency: maintenance tablets plus an antibody, with a real survival benefit proven exactly in this group - the test that found the deficiency is what earned this card.

Newly diagnosed.name: The HR-proficient gap (PRIMA's arc - the reversal reaching front line)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the narrowed landscape (2025-06): no PARP holds a US 1L indication here; bev or observation per fitness
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 3 randomized with NEGATIVE final OS (PRIMA, verified) - the reversal card, labeled, never ranked
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the gap's honest cost is uncertainty, not drug toxicity - and the trial door is often the best answer
Newly diagnosed.patient: For tumors WITHOUT the DNA-repair deficiency: the maintenance tablet that used to be offered here was pulled back in 2025 after long-term results showed it did not extend life - so the honest menu is the antibody, careful observation, or a trial built exactly for this gap. This card exists to say t…

Newly diagnosed.name: The LGS / clear-cell / mucinous branch (own biologies, own new approvals)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: avutometinib+defactinib accelerated approval 2025-05-08 (KRASmut LGSOC, secondhand); the rest guideline/trial-grade
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized phase 2/3 for LGS (GOG-281); accelerated approval (RAMP-201); phase 2 signals elsewhere - labeled
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: by biology: MEK-class rash and eye checks; endocrine gentleness; the honest note that platinum underperforms in this branch
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the rarer types: each has its own biology and - newly - its own real options, including the first drug ever approved specifically for low-grade serous disease (2025). The evidence is younger than the main type's, and every card says so.
drugs: Avutometinib+defactinib (KRASmut LGS) / trametinib / endocrine / GI-style regimens

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none from therapy; ascites and bowel care are the craft
Newly diagnosed.patient: Declining cancer-directed treatment is a real choice - with a team whose craft includes the swelling and bowel problems this disease can cause.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Secondary cytoreduction (the honest pair - DESKTOP III vs GOG-0213)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: selected patients only (AGO criteria spirit; NCCN secondhand)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: phase 3 randomized x2 with OPPOSITE verdicts (DESKTOP III positive, GOG-0213 negative) - the disagreement is the curriculum
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: a second major operation, justified only where selection predicts complete resection
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: For relapse after a long treatment-free interval: a second operation helped in one major trial and not in another - the difference was WHO was selected. For the right candidate (fit, no fluid, a complete first surgery), it added real months; the honest first step is checking whether that is you.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Platinum retreatment (the sensitive-relapse standard, measured live)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: sensitive-relapse standard (NCCN secondhand); the withdrawal ledger carried
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: randomized control-arm measurement (DESKTOP III's chemo arm) + the class's regulatory history
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: the familiar platinum season, again - with the honest note that each interval tends to shorten
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: The proven move for relapse after a long interval: the platinum family again - it usually works again, and what follows it depends honestly on which maintenance drugs were already used.
drugs: Carboplatin doublet (+/- bev); maintenance per exposure history

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Mirvetuximab soravtansine (MIRASOL - the FRa door)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: the ocular ledger is the signature (blurred vision, keratopathy - steroid drops and eye exams are part of the prescription)
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: For resistant disease whose tumor carries the folate-receptor marker: a guided-missile drug that beat chemotherapy on survival itself - the first of its kind here.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Pembrolizumab + paclitaxel (KEYNOTE-B96 - the first IO approval, 2026-02)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: phase 3 randomized - PFS and OS met (Lancet 2026, PMID matched)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: weekly-taxane rhythm plus the immune ledger - the combination's price for the disease's first IO win
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: For resistant disease with the PD-L1 marker: immunotherapy plus weekly chemotherapy - the first immune-drug approval this disease has ever had, earned this February on survival evidence.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Relacorilant + nab-paclitaxel (ROSELLA - the no-biomarker door, 2026-03)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: FDA-approved 2026-03-25, platinum-resistant, 1-3 prior regimens (secondhand - label at refresh)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: phase 3 randomized - OS met (ROSELLA; readout verified, publication details at refresh)
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: the taxane ledger with the GR-antagonist's drug-interaction homework (a real pharmacy conversation)
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: The newest resistant-disease option, needing no biomarker: a tablet that blocks stress-hormone signaling paired with chemotherapy - approved this March on a real survival gain.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Comfort-focused care
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: teaching estimate (flagged); randomized control-arm brackets verified
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: Choosing comfort in resistant disease is a real road - with the fluid-and-bowel craft as active care, not absence of care.

Konstantinopoulos et al. Germline and Somatic Tumor Testing in Epithelial Ovarian Cancer: ASCO Guideline - universal germline for all EOC, reflex somatic BRCA if germline-negative, dMMR for endometrioid/clear-cell/mucinous. JCO 2020 (PMID 31986064, pubmed-url-match; summary PMID 32074015)

Vergote et al. EORTC 55971: neoadjuvant chemotherapy then interval debulking non-inferior to primary surgery in stage IIIC/IV - and residual tumor (the R0 principle) the strongest prognostic factor. NEJM 2010;363:943-53 (PMID 20818904, pubmed-url-match)
Kehoe et al. CHORUS: primary chemotherapy vs primary surgery - NACT an acceptable standard (non-inferiority met). Lancet 2015;386:249-57 (PMID 26002111, pubmed-url-match)
Ozols et al. GOG-158: carboplatin-paclitaxel non-inferior to cisplatin-paclitaxel with less toxicity - the backbone's receipt. JCO 2003;21:3194-200 (PMID 12860964, pubmed-url-match)

Burger et al. GOG-218: bevacizumab-throughout - PFS 14.1 vs 10.3 months, NO OS benefit (final OS PMID 31216226, matched); ICON7 concordant (PMID 22204725 + OS 26115797, matched) - bev's PFS-only receipts, said plainly. NEJM 2011;365:2473-83 (PMID 22204724, pubmed-url-match)

van Driel et al. OVHIPEC-1: HIPEC at interval debulking after NACT (stage III) - RFS 14.2 vs 10.7, OS 45.7 vs 33.9 months; single trial, contested uptake, option-grade. NEJM 2018;378:230-40, DOI NEJMoa1708618 (PMID 29342393 - WRONG-PMID CATCH #25: an IDENTICAL-TITLE NEJM correspondence carries PMID 29619815 and poses as the paper in searches; the original was disambiguated by DOI - never cite 29619815)

Moore et al. SOLO-1: maintenance olaparib in newly diagnosed BRCA-mutant advanced disease - the maintenance era's founding receipt. NEJM 2018;379:2495-505 (PMID 30345884, pubmed-url-match; 5-yr follow-up PMID 34715071, matched)

DiSilvestro et al. SOLO-1 7-year OS: HR 0.55 (CI 0.40-0.76; prespecified threshold not met - said honestly; ~67% alive BRCAm, the tail figure carried flagged). JCO 2023 (PMID 36082969, pubmed-url-match)

Ray-Coquard et al. PAOLA-1: olaparib + bevacizumab 1L maintenance - benefit driven entirely by HRD-positive disease; none in HRD-negative (the trial that made the HRD test mandatory). NEJM 2019;381:2416-28 (PMID 31851799, pubmed-url-match)

Ray-Coquard et al. PAOLA-1 final OS: survival benefit in HRD-positive disease (exact figures: pull from paper at refresh - carried qualitatively per sweep). Ann Oncol 2023 (PMID 37211045, pubmed-url-match)

PRIMA/ENGOT-OV26 final OS (Gonzalez-Martin et al.): niraparib all-comers 1L maintenance - durable PFS BUT median OS 46.6 vs 48.8 months PLACEBO (no benefit; numerically favoring no treatment); MDS/AML 2.3% vs 1.6%. Ann Oncol 2024 (PMID 39284381, pubmed-url-match; the primary NEJM 2019 PMID 31562799 resisted strict matching - flagged; companion editorial PMID 39900343 matched). LABEL CONSEQUENCE: FDA-requested restriction to HRD-positive, 2025-06 (GSK Dear-HCP, secondhand) - THE REVERSAL WAVE REACHING FRONT LINE

Rustin et al. MRC OV05/EORTC 55955: early vs delayed treatment of CA-125-only relapse - NO survival benefit from treating the marker; the Rustin rule. Lancet 2010;376:1155-63 (PMID 20888993, pubmed-url-match - another identical-title trap dodged: only this PMID matched the exact title)

Harter et al. DESKTOP III: secondary cytoreduction in AGO-SELECTED platinum-sensitive relapse - OS 53.7 vs 46.0 months favoring surgery; 75.5% complete resection (the benefit lives there). NEJM 2021;385:2123-31 (PMID 34874631, pubmed-url-match)

Coleman et al. GOG-0213 (surgery arm): secondary cytoreduction in a BROADER population - NEGATIVE, no OS benefit. The honest pair's other half: selection is the variable. NEJM 2019;381:1929-39 (PMID 31722153, pubmed-url-match)

THE 2022 WITHDRAWAL WAVE (all secondhand-precise via SGO/ASCO Rapid Update/Dear-HCP letters): rucaparib >=3L BRCAm treatment WITHDRAWN 2022-06 (ARIEL4 OS signal); olaparib gBRCAm >=3L treatment WITHDRAWN 2022-08-26 (SOLO3 subgroup - trial PMID 32073956, matched); niraparib >=4L HRD+ QUADRA WITHDRAWN eff. 2022-09-14; niraparib 2L maintenance (NOVA) RESTRICTED to gBRCAm 2022-11-11. Four actions, one lesson - and the wave reached front line in 2025-06 (see primaReversal)

Pujade-Lauraine et al. OReO/ENGOT-ov38: maintenance olaparib RECHALLENGE after prior PARP - modest PFS gains (BRCAm 4.3 vs 2.8 months). Ann Oncol 2023;34:1152-64 (PMID 37797734 claimed but NOT strictly url-matched - FLAGGED; title/journal verified on the publisher)

Moore et al. MIRASOL: mirvetuximab soravtansine vs chemo, FRa-HIGH platinum-resistant - OS 16.46 vs 12.75 months (the sweep corrected a rounding drift - carried exactly), PFS 5.6 vs 3.9; FULL approval 2024-03 (secondhand). The first ADC OS win in this disease. NEJM 2023;389:2162-74 (PMID 38055253, pubmed-url-match)

KEYNOTE-B96/ENGOT-ov65: pembrolizumab + weekly paclitaxel (+/- bev) in platinum-resistant disease - PFS met (CPS>=1 and all-comers); PD-L1+ median OS 18.2 vs 14.0 months. Lancet 2026 (PMID 41974150, pubmed-url-match). FDA approved 2026-02-10 for PD-L1 CPS>=1 (secondhand) - THE FIRST IO APPROVAL IN OVARIAN CANCER

ROSELLA (NCT05257408): relacorilant + nab-paclitaxel in platinum-resistant disease (1-3 prior regimens incl. bev) - OS 16.0 vs 11.9 months (~35% death-risk reduction), PFS met. FDA APPROVED 2026-03-25 (Lifyorli; fda.gov announcement verified in search; label details at refresh) - the no-biomarker door, novel mechanism (GR antagonism)
Pujade-Lauraine et al. AURELIA: bevacizumab + chemotherapy in platinum-resistant disease - PFS improved (the pre-ADC-era resistant receipt). JCO 2014;32:1302-8 (PMID 24637997, pubmed-url-match)
Gershenson et al. GOG-281/LOGS: trametinib vs standard care in recurrent LOW-GRADE serous - positive; the branch's MAPK receipt. Lancet 2022 (PMID 35123694, pubmed-url-match)

Avutometinib + defactinib (AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA co-pack): FDA ACCELERATED approval 2025-05-08 for KRAS-MUTANT recurrent LGSOC after >=1 systemic therapy (RAMP-201, ORR 44%) - the FIRST-EVER LGSOC approval (fda.gov verified in search); RAMP-301 is the confirmatory
PEACOCC: pembrolizumab in advanced clear-cell gynecological cancer - met its primary endpoint (12-week PFS 42%); the clear-cell IO signal. (PMID 39913118, pubmed-url-match)

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

TroFuse-021/GOG-3102 (NCT07318558): sacituzumab tirumotecan (+/- bev) maintenance vs SOC, newly diagnosed advanced HRD-NEGATIVE disease after 1L platinum, phase 3, PFS primary, ~900 pts (Merck/GOG/ENGOT) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08 (cache 2026-05), registry re-check due. The reversal card's trial door

TroFuse-022/GOG-3103 (NCT06824467): sac-TMT (+/- bev) maintenance vs SOC after 2L platinum in platinum-SENSITIVE recurrence (the PARP-exposed population), phase 3, PFS primary (~770-900 pts) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08 (ESMO 2025 TiP), re-check due. GLORIOSA (FRa-high maintenance): status unconfirmed - named, not listed

REJOICE-Ovarian01 (NCT06161025): raludotatug deruxtecan (CDH6 DXd ADC) vs physician's choice, platinum-resistant HGS/endometrioid - PHASE 3 PART enrolling since 2025-12 (phase 2 ORR ~50% at chosen dose; breakthrough designation; NOT approved) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08 (ASCO 2026 TPS), re-check due

HOTT/GOG-3068 (NCT05659381): HIPEC (cisplatin, 90 min, 42C) vs none AT interval debulking, newly diagnosed III/IV - ALL patients get niraparib maintenance (isolating HIPEC in the PARP era), phase 3, PFS primary (MSK-led, GOG network) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08 (site listings current), re-check due

RAMP-301/GOG-3097 (NCT06072781): avutometinib + defactinib vs investigator's choice, recurrent LGSOC (KRAS-mutant AND wild-type, stratified), phase 3, PFS-BICR primary (~270 pts) - the confirmatory behind the 2025-05 accelerated approval - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08, re-check due

NRG-GY036 (NCT06580314): ONE vs TWO years of maintenance olaparib (+/- bev), BRCA-mutant or HRD-positive, response to 1L platinum - NRG's first PRAGMATIC phase 3 (activated 2025-01; NCTN-wide) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08; primary-endpoint wording needs the registry re-check.
